claims: As of April 2026, Mike Brown is the head coach of the New York Knicks.
Mike Brown was named head coach of the New York Knicks on July 7, 2025.
Mike Brown was hired as head coach of the New York Knicks in July 2025 following the departure of Tom Thibodeau.
Mike Brown tied a franchise record with 51 wins in his first season as head coach of the New York Knicks.
In the 2025-26 season, Mike Brown tied Pat Riley (1991-92) for the most wins (51) by a Knicks head coach in their first season.
Before joining the Knicks, Mike Brown was the head coach of the Sacramento Kings.
Mike Brown won NBA Coach of the Year in 2023.
Mike Brown previously served as an assistant coach for four NBA championship teams.
Mike Brown's structured starting five features Jalen Brunson, Josh Hart, Mikal Bridges, OG Anunoby, and Karl-Anthony Towns.
